No confirmed signs of a malicious supply-chain compromise were found. Overall risk: **info**.

Malicious Supply-Chain Indicators

No confirmed malicious supply-chain indicators.

Automatic Execution Paths

  • In the provided text corpus and pre-scan output, there is no evidence of malicious .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, install/build-hook execution, interpreter-start execution, or import-time malicious side effects.
  • setup.py is present, but its presence alone is not evidence of malicious automatic execution. The body of setup.py was not included in the provided corpus, so install-time logic remains an item for follow-up.
  • Normal SDK usage examples, documentation pip install snippets, and user-invoked client methods were not treated as automatic execution evidence.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Stealth

  • **Credential harvesting:** No evidence of broad discovery of environment variables, .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, CI/CD tokens, wallets, or kubeconfig files.
  • **Archive staging / exfiltration:** No evidence of compressing or staging harvested files, or uploading them to attacker-controlled infrastructure.
  • **Network:** References to https://www.alphainfo.io appear to be normal SDK/API/documentation endpoints. No raw IPs, webhooks, paste/drop services, or suspicious C2 domains were identified.
  • **Persistence:** No evidence of cron jobs, systemd units, launch agents, shell-profile edits, or background persistence loops.
  • **Lateral movement:** No evidence of Kubernetes service-account abuse, Docker socket access, cloud metadata access, or GitHub Actions/package-publishing token theft.
  • **Obfuscation/loader:** The pre-scan “encrypted-payload/loader” hits appear to be documentation-language matches such as encoding, eval, or guide, not actual base64/eval/exec/downloader-style loader code.

Distribution Integrity Anomalies

  • Requires-Dist: httpx>=0.25.0, optional h2, and development dependencies such as pytest, mypy, and ruff are consistent with a normal Python SDK.
  • Inclusion of .gitignore in the sdist is a minor packaging artifact, but there is no evidence tying it to a hidden payload or executable logic.
  • No evidence was found for typosquatting, unexplained native binaries, hidden payloads, sudden malicious dependency insertion, or wheel/sdist mismatch in the provided material.

Additional Follow-Up Needed

  • The provided text corpus does not include the full contents of setup.py, pyproject.toml, setup.cfg, alphainfo/client.py, or alphainfo/__init__.py. Reviewing those original files is required to fully rule out install/build-time execution or import-time side effects.
  • If a wheel artifact exists separately, compare it against the sdist and inspect .dist-info contents for file or behavior discrepancies.
